_about: SEED gold set, written by an AI agent (not a person) from the prose docs committed in this repository, NOT from hydrology papers. It exists so the harness runs and gives a first reading. A passage is relevant when its text contains `answer_phrase` (case-insensitive). The questions are paraphrases, but the author read the passages first; treat the numbers as optimistic for every ranker. The kill decision in plans needs the 30-50 question set written by a person from real hydrology papers (bench/literature/README.md).
